what: the ltr-ce-notests cascade timed stage by stage on every SWE-bench Lite issue with a function target; no ranking is scored, so this is not a test-set evaluation

stages.index: build the snapshot index; embeds units not yet in the embedding store
stages.embed_query: embed the issue and its title (GPU), bypassing the query cache
stages.features: lexical and dense scoring, candidate pool, 52 features
stages.ranker: LambdaMART at function and file level
stages.reranker: both adapters over the top candidates (GPU)
